normalized.name: community/sam-video-mask
normalized.description: SAM3 person segmentation of one video into aligned binary frame masks.

video.description: One video file, or a video-source handle containing exactly one video.

masks.description: Ordered p_<i:016d>.png masks; single-channel uint8, 0 background and 255 person.

hololab_root.description: HoloLab checkout supplying the frame-extraction@0.2.0 implementation.

vista_root.description: Vista4D checkout containing sam3 and utils/recon_and_seg/seg_sam3_official.py.

exec.shell: python "{{ pack_dir }}/run.py" --video "{{ inputs.video }}" --output "{{ outputs.masks }}" --scratch "{{ scratch_dir }}" --max-frames "{{ params.max_frames }}" --skip "{{ params.skip }}" --start-frame "{{ params.start_frame }}" --end-frame "{{ params.end_frame }}" --max-width "{{ params.max_width }}" --vista-root "{{ params.vista_root }}" --checkpoint "{{ params.checkpoint }}" --hololab-root "{{ params.hololab_root }}"

environment.boundary: 本地能力检查只覆盖已声明且在可探测范围内的项; 通过不代表一定能运行。环境未冻结、未被代码身份覆盖。
